Class LeaveMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.network.Socket.Message
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.network.Socket.ClientMessage.ClientMessage
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.network.Socket.ClientMessage.LeaveMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LeaveMessage extends ClientMessage
Represents a message sent by the client to request leaving the current game. This message triggers the server to handle the action of the client leaving the game.
